name: Stale sweep
description: Lists stale branches and pull requests, skips protected ones and ones another agent has claimed, and messages each owner once with proposals. It proposes deletions and closes in a summary and never carries them out. Pull requests and deletions need an approval step that arrives in a later version; until then this only reports and files tasks.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Repositories to sweep, such as owner/repo.

protected_patterns.title: Protected branches
protected_patterns.description: Shell-style globs that are never listed.
